sections.title: The Economical Choice for DePIN Operators
sections.body: Profitability in the Render Network is a function of two variables: task revenue and operational cost. While hardware costs are fixed, the price you pay for energy and cooling determines your take-home profit. By hosting nodes at Kenya AI Compute, you benefit from our $0.04/kWh energy rate and professional Tier II+ infrastructure. We manage the hardware, the high-speed connectivity, and the 24/7 uptime, while you collect the rewards. Our Render-optimized racks are designed for maximum thermal stability, ensuring that your GPUs run at peak performance without thermal throttling during intense 3D rendering jobs. This is the industrialization of DePIN—moving from home-based setups to professional-grade infrastructure in the world's most energy-efficient jurisdiction. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
